name: Pullquote on photo — depth stage
description: A pullquote floating over a real photographic substrate on the dimensional depth stage (ADR-0028, dex p20 image-substrate). The atmospheric photo sits on the backdrop plane; the quote + contrast scrim float on the near plane; a slow camera push reprojects them at different rates (real parallax, not a flat overlay), and a rack focus opens defocused on the photo then pulls to the pin-sharp quote. The substrate is a bundled, deterministic in-repo image (atmosphere-warm) resolved to a GPU texture on the backdrop plane's textured branch. backgroundFill is the opaque-lane backstop behind the full-bleed photo.

content.title: Build on bedrock. The tide goes out; bedrock stays.
content.author: Scott Tolinski
